_about: What each vendor itself calls a plugin, per language. Bristlenose says the vendor's own word in that vendor's tab (docs/i18n-vendor-terms.md). 'stem' is a lowercase fragment every string of that vendor's key family must contain, so inflected forms (wtyczkę, lisäosana) still match. Change a row only with evidence from the vendor's app or help centre, and update 'checked'.
